description: POST HTML or a public URL. Strips scripts, styles, nav and footers, converts to Markdown and returns heading-aware chunks with heading paths, token estimates, stable hashes and configurable overlap. For embedding and RAG pipelines. Tables: HTML tables become GitHub-flavored Markdown with a | --- | header row. Nested tables are lifted out as labelled sub-tables under ### Parent row → column headings, with (see Parent → column) in the parent cell. Pipes in cells are escaped as \|. Links inside cells become [text](url); bold, italic and code markers in the link text are kept; the title attribute is dropped; an href that starts with # is not turned into a link. Example: a Basic row with a nested Limits table becomes | Basic | (see Basic → Limits) | plus a ### Basic → Limits sub-table. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
name: html_to_rag
